description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named ModuleScreen within the OrangeHRM system. It encapsulates properties related to a module and screen combination, including optional overridden versions. The class provides constructor methods, getters, and setters for managing these properties, facilitating data handling in the application's module and screen management features.

classes.name: ModuleScreen
classes.description: A DTO class in the OrangeHRM system representing a module and screen with optional overrides.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a ModuleScreen instance with optional module and screen parameters, and sets overridden values accordingly.

methods.name: setModule
methods.description: Sets the module name and updates the overridden module if not already overridden.

methods.name: setScreen
methods.description: Sets the screen name and updates the overridden screen if not already overridden.
